body: Why Log W-14. Andrews, Aksman et al. 2022, Biological Psychiatry (UC Davis MIND; Nordahl, Amaral). 71 autistic + 55 non-autistic children, up to 4 scans, ~2–12 yrs. DSM anxiety: larger amygdala; autism-distinct anxiety: slower right-amygdala growth, smaller by last scan. Nordahl: lumped together, 'the amygdala changes would have canceled each other out.' Fair side: small groups (28/32/16), mostly boys, cause unknown (Amaral: 'really a mystery'). Type: one label, two things, mapped to master question 3 (ruled 2026-10-12).
evidence: Published, peer-reviewed: Andrews, Aksman et al. 2022, Biological Psychiatry
plain: Standard and autism-distinct anxiety track opposite amygdala growth in autistic children; lumped under one label, the differences cancel out.
